scientific.integrity: The connected upper bound is proved by ordering the edge-special lines as a connected intersection system and charging at least two new points to every possible new affine dimension. The tree lower bound is proved by a complete two-vertex induction along a diametral path; a finite enumerative checker stress-tests that reduction on all nonisomorphic trees through order twelve.
scientific.limitations: The universal half-order statement is an upper bound, not an exact formula for arbitrary connected graphs; equality is proved for all trees. The recent literature creates a bounded residual overlap risk despite focused full-text, web, and semantic-database checks.

title: A sharp half-order bound for Sylvester--Gallai dimension of connected graphs
